response.original_title: [Step-by-Step Guide] How Do I Add a Passenger to My Disney Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Disney Cruise reservation 1-866-254-7549, you must call Disney Cruise Line Customer Service at 1-866-254-7549 (or 1-866-254-7549) or contact your travel agent, as passenger additions generally cannot be completed online 1-866-254-7549.Key Requirements Stateroom Capacity: Your current room must have an available bed or berth for the extra guest 1-866-254-7549. If the room is already at maximum capacity 1-866-254-7549, you will need to upgrade to a larger stateroom or book a separate room. Ship Capacity & Lifeboats: Adding a guest is subject to overall ship occupancy limits and lifeboat station safety caps 1-866-254-7549, even if your specific stateroom has space. Booking Source: If you booked through a travel agent or Disney Vacation Club 1-866-254-7549, you must have them make the change for you.Pricing & Fees: You will need to pay the current market rate for the new passenger's cruise fare, taxes, fees, and port charges 1-866-254-7549.
